svg.text: Sleeve: a 150 mm wide strip of 1.5 mm sheet rolled to 230 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top ring: a 230 mm disc with a 160 mm hole; cut six tabs 15 mm wide

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: into the hole edge (before cutting it to size) and fold them up

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 20 mm. Fold or rivet the ring onto the sleeve top.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: slide over the throat, bottom edge 40 mm above the lid (a

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 40 mm block under it while drilling); rivet the six tabs to the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: throat. The air holes sit inside, 55 and 95 mm above its bottom.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Band damper: a 60 mm wide band of 3 mm strip rolled to fit round

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sleeve, with a riveted nut and an M6 wing screw. Open: up on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the sleeve; closed: slid down to the lid.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the band slides and the wing screw holds it.
